{{Top}}
{{Quote|She's taken ''a lot'' of damage, Chewie. One of her droid brains is ''fried''.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]|<ref name="Repairs">{{SWComicCite|7.5|Repairs}}</ref>}}
[[File:Falcon_droid_brains.jpg|thumb|right|The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] used droid brains from an [[R3-series astromech droid/Legends|R3-series astromech droid]], a [[V-5 transport droid/Legends|V-5 transport droid]], and a [[Slicer droid/Legends|slicer droid]].]]
A '''droid brain''', also known as a '''cognitive module''' or '''logic processor''',<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> was a computer that was the central processing area of a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. Without one, a droid could not function. Droid brains were also used in [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] and [[Droid tank/Legends|tanks]].

Another use for droid brains was in starships, where they were used for operating and navigating the ship. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], for instance, had three different droid brains, which caused the ''Falcon'' to have [[Schizophrenia|schizophrenic]] arguments with itself. Despite this, under desperate circumstances the three brains managed to work together, stumping many trying to hack into the ''Falcon''.

The company [[Gentik]] was known for specializing in designs for droid brains.
